name: How should I prepare for an initial interior remodeling consultation?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare for an initial interior remodeling consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before consulting a remodeling contractor, compile a list of practical functional issues, design preferences, and your target investment range. Take inventory of how you use each space daily: determine whether you need improved kitchen storage, better bathroom ventilation, or a reconfiguration of closed-off rooms into an open living area. Gather visual examples of trim styles, cabinet finishes, and flooring choices you prefer. Having these details documented, along with a firm understanding of any must-have features versus nice-to-have items, helps your contractor evaluate the feasibility of your project and produce a realistic plan.
acceptedAnswer.description: List your layout issues, compile design preferences, establish a spending range, and separate must-have features from optional upgrades.
